title: Priority reservoir and deferment protocol for high-risk customer commitments
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Design a systematic mechanism that lets Product reserve limited roadmap capacity for a small set of high-risk (strategic / top-tier) customers while preserving predictable delivery for the broader roadmap. The mechanism ("priority reservoir") pairs: 1) a timeboxed reservation of scoped effort (credit units) for qualifying accounts and 2) a formal deferred-scope protocol that defines what gets delivered immediately vs deferred, how scope is decomposed, and compensation paths. Goal: reduce unstructured ad-hoc escalations, give PMs a repeatable negotiation lever, and preserve engineering predictability.
acceptance_criteria: Specification for priority reservoir model published (eligibility, credit sizing, expiry, transfer rules)
Workflow in Console for reserving credits and attaching to account(s) implemented in spec (UI mock + API contract)
Deferment protocol doc with templates for scoped MVP, fallback features, and customer communication signed-off by Sales/CS/Legal
Operational ledger design (how credits are consumed, audit trail for commitments) reviewed by Finance and Compliance
Playbook with examples and 3 worked scenarios (urgent enterprise request, negotiated pilot, SLA-triggered escalation) validated by Solutions Eng
success_metrics: Reduction in ad-hoc VIP feature escalations routed to Engineering by 45% within first quarter of launch
% of reserved credits consumed as planned vs converted to emergency work < 20%
Average lead time for priority-committed deliverables within negotiated window >= 90%
Net promoter score from pilot customers for commitment transparency >= +20

decision_log: 2026-02-20: Agreed to pilot reservoir with 5 strategic accounts, 3-month reservation windows, credits measured in story-point-equivalents (SPE)
2026-03-02: Chose non-transferable, non-refundable credit default; allowed one negotiated transfer with authorization
2026-03-09: Legal approved customer-facing deferment language; Finance requested additional audit fields in ledger
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (spec): finalize eligibility rubric and credit accounting (2 weeks)
Phase 1 (pilot): implement Console reservation flow + API and run with 5 accounts (6 weeks)
Phase 2 (ops): automate ledger exports, billing integration, and reporting dashboards (4 weeks)
Phase 3 (scale): document playbooks, train Solutions and AMs, open self-serve application for prioritized tier (ongoing)
Fallback: if >30% of reserved credits become emergency work in pilot, pause new reservations and update protocol
risks: Overpromising: reservoirs create perceived entitlement that leaks into org without strict eligibility checks
Engineering churn: frequent priority interrupts may degrade overall sprint predictability
Accounting complexity: credit accounting and refunds require Finance integration and auditability
Legal exposure: ambiguous deferment language could create SLA disputes
Sales behavior: risk of strategic customers lobbying for larger reservoirs than justified
